note: The built core combines this repository's integration (GPL-2.0-or-later) with rawgl, Gregory Montoir's reimplementation of Another World's engine, compiled in from the submodule extern/rawgl (github.com/cyxx/rawgl); miniz (MIT), which reads the project's zip; zlib (the zlib licence), which inflates the 20th Anniversary Edition's gzip files; stb_vorbis (public domain or MIT), which decodes its Ogg Vorbis music; and TinySoundFont (MIT), which plays Windows 3.1's MIDI music. rawgl's repository carries no licence file and its sources name the author's copyright without terms; its predecessor, raw, is distributed by others under the GPL (Fabien Sanglard's Another-World-Bytecode-Interpreter, GPL-2.0), but rawgl itself grants nothing in writing. Until its author states terms, this package is for private use: do not redistribute it. The integration is GPL-2.0-or-later so that it stays compatible with whichever GPL rawgl's terms turn out to be. The package carries none of Another World's data, and no SoundFont: the game's files and a SoundFont are the project's, supplied by the user.
